category_edits.rationale: Learn one scalar sigmoid residual gate per causal block, initialized to 0.5 to preserve the incumbent starting behavior. All four category models retain their causal convolutions, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Gates are jointly trained and saved in each model's single checkpoint; predictor metadata checks identify the updated architecture.

edits.find:
if meta.get("residual_scale") != 0.5:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Incompatible residual scale metadata for {ds}")
edits.replace:
if meta.get("residual_gate") != "per_block_sigmoid_init_0.5":
            raise RuntimeError(f"Incompatible residual gate metadata for {ds}")

change_summary: Replace fixed residual scaling with jointly learned per-block sigmoid gates initialized to 0.5, with matching metadata and embedded predictor checks.
